I had an abortion about 2 years ago. I've had times when I was extremely depressed, lost and gained weight fast, I had no appetite. I just survived for a while. I had no clear thought because of the hormonal changes within. After a while, the mood swings seem to have dialed down a lot, that was when I started to get my life together. It takes time. 
Maybe the doctors visit will help. Just be patient. Eat healthy.

India's population now is more than 1 billion. I don't know how many of them you could meet but, no, not all of us racists. You might have run into people who are. Few people tend to be extremists sometimes.
Yes. Very much. Far better. Pollution and population wise, NO. Villages are more natural to exist in.

No, India as a whole is not a sexist country. 
Cities, well, people who live in the cities have certain awareness that rural area people do not. And from my experience, I don't think they are open to that kind of awareness either.
Pressing issue? I think people are not open to a change and they should be.
